video_title: Perk Says The Knicks Are In A MUST-WIN Game 4

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks must win Game 4 to avoid a series deficit
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks they better not drop that game. I don't give a damn what the regular record said.
quotes.quote: The Knicks they better not drop that game. I don't give a damn what the regular record said. Look, the Knicks are in a must-win situation. There is no way in hell you go and capture both road games, come home to lose both? You better not. It's going to be hell and high water.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet and Michael Bridges struggled defensively in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: Landry Shamet and Mikal Bridges were ass last night.
quotes.quote: Landry Shamet and Mikal Bridges were ass last night.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' defensive game plan against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart, anybody but Victor Wembanyama can get touches.
quotes.quote: If I'm the Spurs, here is my game plan last game: Josh Hart, anybody but Victor Wembanyama can get touches. Seriously, because you go, okay, Paul George, he's going to go off, but we can, that's only such a big bomb. Victor Wembanyama is like to me how we treated Paul George. We look down the roster and go, all right, this dude solid, what's max, 20? This dude solid, max 18? This dude solid. Then you look at Paul George, you go, yo, if he gets hot, he get 60, 50. This one dude can beat us. If Victor Wembanyama is hot, they don't, the Spurs don't have an answer for.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama's leadership is demonstrated through his actions
quotes.excerpt: The leadership of Victor Wembanyama, not just saying the right things but leading by actions.
quotes.quote: The leadership of Victor Wembanyama, not just saying the right things but leading by actions. Saying, you know what, putting this pride aside to say, you know what, coach, all right, cool, I do want to check Paul George, I do want to do that. But if the game plan is for me to be on Josh Hart and be a roamer, I do that and I do it to the best of my ability and anchor the defense like y'all want me to.
